en: the set of business practices that support producers in developing countries by doing things like paying fair prices and making sure that workers have good working conditions and fair pay
ex: Fair trade is giving some small coffee farmers a safety net in a difficult market.
公平贸易为一些小型咖啡农提供了在困难市场中的安全网。

zh: a statement of legal policy that allows people to use short pieces of copyright material without permission for news reporting, teaching, research, etc.
en: a statement of legal policy that allows people to use short pieces of copyright material without permission for news reporting, teaching, research, etc.
ex: His use of the lyrics constitutes fair use under copyright law.
根据版权法，他对歌词的使用构成合理使用。

en: with light or blonde hair
looking at and judging things in a fair and open way
ex: A fair-minded employer will not try to stop you from joining a union.
有主见的雇主不会试图阻止您加入工会。

zh: 公平贸易的（尤指支持发展中国家在价格、工人工资等方面实行公平政策）
en: involving trade that supports producers in developing countries by paying fair prices and making sure that workers have good working conditions and fair pay
ex: We buy 10% of our bananas from fair-trade sources.
我们 10% 的香蕉是通过公平贸易渠道购买的。

zh: 同甘不共苦的；只在顺境中的
en: behaving in a particular way or doing a particular activity only when it is pleasant for them
ex: a fair-weather friend (= somebody who stops being a friend when you are in trouble)
不能共患难的朋友

zh: 商品交易会场址；展销会场地
en: an outdoor area where a fair with entertainments is held
ex: the Ohio State Fairgrounds
俄亥俄州农畜产品集市场地

en: to some extent but not very
ex: fairly simple/easy/straightforward
相当简单/容易/简单

en: the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is reasonable
ex: The fairness of the judicial system is being questioned.
司法制度的公正性受到质疑。

en: the long area of short grass that you must hit the ball along before you get to the green and the hole
ex: Keep the ball on the fairways.
将球保持在球道上。

zh: （故事中的）小仙人，仙子，小精灵
en: (in stories) a creature like a small person, who has magic powers
ex: a good/wicked fairy
善良的仙子；邪恶的精灵

en: a small cake, baked in a paper container that is like a cup in shape and often with icing on top

zh: a female character who has magic powers and brings good luck to the main character
en: a female character who has magic powers and brings good luck to the main character
ex: Cinderella's fairy godmother appears and sends her to the ball in a beautiful carriage.
灰姑娘的仙女教母出现，并用漂亮的马车把她送到舞会上。

zh: （尤指挂在圣诞树上的）彩色小灯
en: small white or coloured electric lights used for decoration, especially on a tree at Christmas
